# Shvarzman Consulting

> Independent contact center, AI and Salesforce consultancy based in Miami, FL, founded by Sean Shvarzman. Strategy, architecture and hands-on delivery of Salesforce Service Cloud, Service Cloud Voice, Agentforce Contact Center, Agentforce Voice agents and CCaaS transformations for US enterprises. 30+ enterprise CX programs, $30M+ in service transformations architected and delivered.

## Pages

- [Home](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/): services, how I work, typical results, FAQ and a free 30-minute discovery call.
- [Salesforce Service Cloud Voice implementation](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/salesforce-service-cloud-voice/): Service Cloud Voice as the integration of a telephony system with Salesforce, partner telephony and Agentforce Contact Center, Agentforce Voice agents replacing IVR menu trees, what I deliver, typical results, FAQ.
- [Agentforce implementation for customer service](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/agentforce/): what Agentforce is, where it pays back, scoping, grounding, measurement, FAQ.
- [CCaaS migration to Salesforce](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/ccaas-migration/): migrating from Genesys, Five9, NICE CXone, Avaya or Amazon Connect, wave cutover, FAQ.
- [AI call deflection ROI calculator](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/ai-deflection-roi-calculator/): formula, assumptions (30% deflection of routine contacts, $35 fully loaded hourly cost) and how to build a real business case.

- [All services](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/services/): engagement types, services, platform guides and tools.
- [Genesys Cloud with Service Cloud Voice](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/genesys-cloud-with-service-cloud-voice/): four ways to run Genesys with Salesforce, from partner telephony under Service Cloud Voice to consolidation, and how to decide.
- [Five9 with Service Cloud Voice](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/five9-with-service-cloud-voice/): inbound in Salesforce, when the dialer keeps Five9 in place, and when to consolidate.
- [NICE CXone with Service Cloud Voice](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/nice-cxone-with-service-cloud-voice/): keep workforce engagement under Service Cloud Voice, move the desktop, or consolidate.
- [About Sean Shvarzman](https://shvarzmanconsulting.com/about/): background, how I work, platforms, industries and clients.
